Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: private-controlplane-high-p99-latency for customer=Hummingbird-Health env=prod region=us-west-2
Incident Bot: alert_id=pcp-87231 severity=page metric=p99_controlplane_rpc_latency value=1.9s threshold=1.0s
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty: Incident triggered -> Escalation policy 'Private VPC Critical' paging Sam Chen (on-call)
Sam Chen: acked :white_check_mark: I'm on it. pulling runbook now -> https://redwood.runbooks/private-controlplane
Maya Rodriguez: ping - are we seeing any other customers?
Sam Chen: quick check - grafana shows 3 customers with p95 > 800ms, Hummingbird is worst. Seems correlated to control-plane queueing on nodes cp-03/cp-04.
Sam Chen: logs -> `curl -s https://logs.redwood/prod/controlplane?query=queue_depth|tail` shows enqueue latency spike starting 2165007600
Kyle Patel: I see increased RPC retry rates from onprem-agent to controlplane for Hummingbird agent hummingbird-agent-12 (10.2.3.45). heartbeat_stalls and long GC pauses? attaching JVM thread dump link.
Sam Chen: @NetEng Bot can you confirm if there was any network maintenance or BGP flaps in us-west-2 around that time?
NetEng Bot: No scheduled maintenance. BGP flaps detected? no. There's a short egress route hiccup at 2165007702 affecting gw-a1 but control plane path remains intact.
Sam Chen: Steps: 1) attempt graceful agent reconnect for hummingbird-agent-12 2) scale up control-plane pool (add cp-05) 3) if still degraded, fail traffic to standby control-plane in us-west-1.
Maya Rodriguez: I'm taking step 1 (agent side). Can someone run `redwoodctl agent restart --customer hummingbird --agent-id hummingbird-agent-12`?
Sam Chen: running now (exec logs pasted):
```
$ redwoodctl agent restart --customer hummingbird --agent-id hummingbird-agent-12
2026-03-14T18:17:42Z initiating restart
2026-03-14T18:17:45Z agent shutting down connections
2026-03-14T18:17:58Z agent started, heartbeat=ok
```
Sam Chen: restart returned healthy heartbeat but controlplane latency still high, p99 down from 1.9s -> 1.6s.
Kyle Patel: scaling control-plane pool now: `kubectl scale deployment ctrl-plane --replicas=5 -n redwood-controlplane`
Incident Bot: autoscaler triggered add cp-05 at 2165007960
Sam Chen: cp-05 joined, warm caches building. p95 dropping, p99 at 1.1s now.
Elena Morales (Hummingbird Health): @Sam thanks for the quick updates. We're seeing some increased API retries on our side but everything is returning now. Any ETA to full recovery?
Sam Chen: ETA 10-15m for p99 under 500ms. Monitoring traces and KV cache warmness.
Maya Rodriguez: I'm taking handoff in 20m. Logging the actions in incident doc -> https://incidents.redwood/2165007890
Sam Chen: ok handing off to @Maya, leaving notes: restarted agent, added cp-05, no network maint, root cause likely control-plane enqueue backlog due to sudden GC spikes on cp-03.
Maya Rodriguez: acknowledged, I'm primary now. Will keep customer updated and coordinate postmortem. Please escalate to Eng-ML if we need GC tunings on cp image.
NetEng Bot: Noted. No further network anomalies.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident acknowledged by Sam Chen, reassigned to Maya Rodriguez at 2165008100. Escalation timer paused.
Maya Rodriguez: contacting Elena via email to confirm degradation window and ask for any request IDs/examples for our evals.
Elena Morales (Hummingbird Health): sent a couple request ids in DMs to Sam. Thanks.
Maya Rodriguez: marking mitigations: agent restart, scale cp pool, monitor p99, collect heapdump from cp-03. Scheduling heapdump now (will be non-disruptive).
Sam Chen: collecting heapdump link -> https://dumps.redwood/cp-03/2165008105.hprof
Maya Rodriguez: heapdump collected. Next steps: postmortem, GC tuning, consider auto-scale threshold adjustment for sudden enqueue bursts.
Sam Chen: closing page as customer impact resolved. will follow up with RCA draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Maya Rodriguez at 2165008250.
